instructions: Author 6-12 claims total, covering all 6 sections (1-2 claims per section).
Every claim MUST have: section, claim_text, quoted_span, source_url, source_text.
quoted_span is the VERBATIM substring you can ctrl-F in the source page (Pitfall 1.1 defense).
source_text is a snapshot of the whole paragraph/section you pulled the quote from — captured at write-time so eval reproducibility survives web drift (D-04).
Sections: founders, company, market, product, risk, suggested_questions.
Good Pickle sources: getpickle.ai landing page, TechCrunch coverage, demo videos (pull dialogue from video descriptions / blog posts, not video-only content since Phase 4 retrieval is text-based).

claims.claim_text: Replace with a single-sentence factual claim.
claims.quoted_span: Replace with the VERBATIM substring from the source.
claims.source_text: Replace with a paragraph-length snapshot of the source text at authoring time (D-04).
